namingRule: Use the exact fileBase below. Add only the selected extension. Do not put text or voice names into the filename; the voice profile is represented by the parent directory.
deliveryRules: Generate every phrase as a separate file.
Audition every generated file for stress, clipped consonants, unintended emotion and excessive end silence.
Keep the text field as UI/transcript copy and send ttsMarkup to SpeechKit.
Do not synthesize at session runtime; ship pregenerated assets.
Never hard-cut a phrase to fit a phase. Reject and rewrite or resynthesize it.
Keep original WAV masters; create AAC/M4A and Opus/Ogg delivery copies.
